title: Youthful Springy Canadian Beef Burger
description: A winey and romantic Canadian dish featuring sesame seed burger buns and rest-meat, served in a dolsot-stone-bowl. This gluten-free-friendly burger is perfect for a spring evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the ground beef, reduced red wine, and a pinch of salt and pepper until just combined.
Form the beef mixture into 4 patties and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the patties in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until they reach an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the patties are cooking, toast the sesame seed burger buns by placing them on the oven rack for 2 minutes.
Assemble the burgers by spreading mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked patty, a slice of cheese, a few slices of onion, a few slices of mushroom, a lettuce leaf, and a tomato slice.
Drizzle the top of each burger with dijon mustard and place the top bun on each burger.
Serve the burgers in a dolsot-stone-bowl and enjoy immediately.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as parsley or thyme, if desired.
